def transform(grid):
    """Project the marker color inward from matching bars on opposite borders."""
    from collections import Counter

    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

    # Compare opposite border pairs; bars of the same color identify the beam axis.
    sides = {
        "top": [g[0][c] for c in range(w)],
        "bottom": [g[h - 1][c] for c in range(w)],
        "left": [g[r][0] for r in range(h)],
        "right": [g[r][w - 1] for r in range(h)],
    }
    pairs = [("top", "bottom"), ("left", "right")]
    candidates = []
    for a, b in pairs:
        ca, cb = Counter(v for v in sides[a] if v != bg), Counter(v for v in sides[b] if v != bg)
        for color in ca.keys() & cb.keys():
            candidates.append((ca[color] + cb[color], color, a, b))
    if not candidates:
        return g
    _, bar, side_a, side_b = max(candidates)

    marks = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if g[r][c] != bg and g[r][c] != bar]
    if not marks:
        return g
    ink = g[marks[0][0]][marks[0][1]]

    def runs(coords):
        out = []
        for x in coords:
            if not out or x > out[-1][-1] + 1:
                out.append([x])
            else:
                out[-1].append(x)
        return out

    def project(side, index):
        if side == "top":
            locs = [c for c in range(w) if g[0][c] == bar]
            dr, dc = 1, 0
        elif side == "bottom":
            locs = [c for c in range(w) if g[h - 1][c] == bar]
            dr, dc = -1, 0
        elif side == "left":
            locs = [r for r in range(h) if g[r][0] == bar]
            dr, dc = 0, 1
        else:
            locs = [r for r in range(h) if g[r][w - 1] == bar]
            dr, dc = 0, -1
        for run in runs(locs):
            x = run[(len(run) - 1) // 2]
            if side == "top": r, c = 0, x
            elif side == "bottom": r, c = h - 1, x
            elif side == "left": r, c = x, 0
            else: r, c = x, w - 1
            r += dr
            c += dc
            while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:
                if g[r][c] == ink:
                    g[r][c] = 4
                    break
                if g[r][c] == bg:
                    g[r][c] = ink
                r += dr
                c += dc

    project(side_a, 0)
    project(side_b, 1)
    return g
